title: Weak Sounds and the Schwa
subtitle: Why native speakers sound fast and why listening feels difficult
description: English uses weak sounds and reduced vowels in normal speech. Spanish vowels are always clear. This sheet helps Spanish learners hear and use weak sounds naturally at B1 level.

categories.title: Weak Function Words
categories.description: Small grammar words are not stressed in English and become very short in normal speech.

sentences.sentence: I want to GO to the STORE.
This is a CUP of TEA.

categories.title: Schwa Inside Words
categories.description: Unstressed syllables inside words become weak and short. English usually has one strong syllable.

sentences.sentence: She lives in aBOUT three MInutes away.

categories.title: Sentence Rhythm
categories.description: English rhythm comes from strong and weak words, not from speaking fast.
